name: example-prompt-ab
notes: Template: BASELINE IS PRODUCTION. models[] is pinned to the live production model (gemini-omni-1.1-flash, direct Gemini — VIDEO_PROVIDER=gemini on adgen-renderer), so the baseline cell is literally what we ship today and each variant is measured against it. Change the model only when the experiment IS about the model. The 'directives' lever is deliberately absent — the live video prompt is one frozen CORE paragraph, so per-element directives are inert (identical prompt, still bills ~$1.00). Only guidance / raw / patch change what is submitted. For a single video with no comparison, use starter-single-video.json.

variants.guidance: HOOK-FIRST: the product must be unmistakably identifiable within the first second; the opening frames carry the whole ad.

patch.find: camera may push, pull, pan, orbit, or cut
patch.replace: camera may push, pull, or pan — one continuous take, no cuts and no orbit
